key.text: key = hex(SHA-256(UTF-8(canonical JSON of {v:1, id, language, kind, toolchain:{id,parts}, action:{argv,env}, interface:(kind or null), outputs (sorted), sources:[[path,digest]] sorted by path, inputs:[[path,digest]] sorted by path, externals sorted, dependencies:[[unit,use,digest]] sorted by unit}))). The dependency digest is the interface closure of the dependency for use `interface`, its output closure for `implementation`, the empty string for `declared`. A path digest is the SHA-256 of the file bytes, `absent` for a missing file. interfaceClosure(u) = SHA-256 of canonical JSON {i: interface digest of u, d: [[dependency id, its interfaceClosure] for every `interface` dependency the executor reported as exposed by the interface (all of them when it reported none), sorted by id]}, null when u has no interface. outputClosure(u) = SHA-256 of canonical JSON {o: outputs digest of u, d: [[dependency id, its outputClosure] for every `interface` or `implementation` dependency, sorted by id]}. Canonical JSON: object keys sorted by code point, no whitespace, strings exactly as JSON.stringify writes them. Every sorted list is sorted by code point (UTF-8 byte order).

python.api: The interface of a module is SHA-256 over the lines `polyglot-python-api-v1` and then, in source order, one line `<depth>|<tokens>` per structural statement, where tokens are the lexical tokens (comments, blank lines, docstrings and formatting dropped) joined by one space. Structural statements: the header of every def, class, if, elif, else, try, except, finally, with, for and while at module or class level (function bodies are skipped; class and compound bodies are walked, depth is the nesting), decorators of public defs and classes, public names only (a name is public unless it starts with a single underscore; dunder names are public; `__all__` entries are public). Imports count when they bind a public name through `import x as x`, `from m import n as n`, `from m import *`, appear in `__all__`, or the module is a package `__init__`. Assignments to public names count: annotated `NAME: ann` by annotation only (with the value for `Final` and for class-level annotated fields), unannotated `NAME = value` with the value tokens. `__all__` statements count whole. A final line `names|<sorted names bound at structural level, private included, plus * when the module cannot enumerate them>` lets importers check `from m import n`. A sibling `.pyi` replaces the module's source for the interface.

cutoff.en: {unit}: rebuilt, interface unchanged (dependents keep their results)
cutoff.de: {unit}: neu gebaut, Schnittstelle unverändert (Abhängige behalten ihre Ergebnisse)
